ops.body: Concrete fix approach (from Stage-1 codex finding #1, the post-reread/pre-write TOCTOU in writeCredCAS): cc-pool's daemon refresh+write must acquire claude's OWN per-account lock — the .oauth_refresh.lock mkdir/rmdir lock dir in the account config dir (see internal/overlay/classify.go:77-89, kept PrivateEntry) — for true mutual exclusion with an in-session claude on the origin. Not a bolt-on: needs (a) an RE pass on claude's CURRENT lock protocol (mkdir-dir vs flock? staleness/PID? release = rmdir) against the installed binary, (b) a staleness/timeout policy so a crashed claude holding the dir can't deadlock cc-pool, (c) deadlock-freedom vs cc-pool's own acct-NN.lock ordering. Fragile dependency boundary (claude can change the lock) — re-verify against vendored/RE source each claude bump. The cross-machine redesign (db150a6) does NOT make this worse: FIX B/C (full-credential CAS compare + owned-never-buried) close every race visible at the CAS reread, and stripped peer blobs eliminate the peer-side case; this is the ORIGIN-only residual microsecond window that only a shared lock closes.
